description: Switch a map background under the garden on or off. 'osm' is the live OpenStreetMap map, about 100 m around the plot, turning with the garden; 'satellite' is the aerial photo of the same area (Poland only: the national orthophoto; elsewhere it answers that there is no photo) — fences, hedges, trees and paths show there, not on the street map. Both need the garden's place (set_geo_anchor or import_parcel), are loaded live and start off each time the garden opens. 'survey' is the survey map laid with set_survey_map (false hides it, true shows it again). They show in capture_preview and hide with the 'map' layer.

visible.description: true to show it, false to remove it

name: set_map_background
